messages.content: You are a hired inference provider in the Union's work-lot market. In 3 sentences or fewer, answer plainly.

"A dispatcher hires one provider per 5-minute tick from a pool of 6 standing providers. Each hire settles in under 30 seconds. Roughly what fraction of the pool's steady-state concurrent capacity is being used, and what is the simplest dispatch change to raise it?"
